player_prompt.intro:
Jumaxa Player {player_id} uka **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Qillqaña t'aqanaka **[macro  micro]** (paya número 0-8):
• *macro*  = kuna mini-tablero uka juk'ampi
• *micro* = kuna cuadrado uka mini-tablero juk'ampi
Ejemplo `[7 8]` ➜ qillqaña marca uka mini-tablero 7, cuadrado 8, ukat
juk'ampi contrincante uka mini-tablero 8 juk'ampi.

Jumaxa `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Uka movimiento ukax [macro micro] ukch'pachapiniñapawa 0-8 jakhunakampi.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, row jan ukax column ukanx janiw jak'ankkiti.

game_action.played: Jaqi {player_id} p'unchawarakiwa micro p'acha {macro_idx}, selula {micro_idx} (p'anku {row}, kulluqi {col}). Jaqi {opponent_id} kuniwa p'unchawi {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Juqiru {player_id} atipt'iwa Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
